sha256-fd-v1:b83c72b092957d4ee273b49996f.description: Assemble adventurers in Utsuro and descend the Black Tower to seek an artifact said to grant eternal youth. Map its first-person maze, manage the party, and survive turn-based encounters.
sha256-fd-v1:b83c72b092957d4ee273b49996f.title: The Black Onyx

sha256-hdi-v1:b807fbe8bd787047c7c1ccc3c6.description: Robbed on his return to a town with an unresolved mystery, a young man enters its mahjong circuit to earn money and uncover what happened to a woman he once saw attacked.
sha256-hdi-v1:b807fbe8bd787047c7c1ccc3c6.title: Jan Jaka Jan

sha256-hdi-v1:b86e393782d523de0f4d454310.description: Student Kouji repeatedly dreams of a mysterious space station and its crew. His teacher urges him to investigate, and the line between the dream and his waking life begins to dissolve.
sha256-hdi-v1:b86e393782d523de0f4d454310.title: Xenon: Mugen no Shitai
